prompt: A photorealistic product-render presentation sheet showing SIX separate everyday desk objects arranged in a perfectly even grid of 3 columns and 2 rows: the empty-state visuals of a calm, premium banking app, in the style of the modern 3D object visuals of Revolut and Qonto. Background: one seamless pure white #FFFFFF studio sweep, completely flat, no horizon line, no vignette, no gradient, no table surface. Every object stands alone in its own invisible cell, centred, all six at the same scale and the same visual size (each about 50 percent of its cell width), with wide empty white space between them so that no two objects or shadows touch. One photographed set with identical treatment: The same camera for every object (a slightly elevated three-quarter view from about 30 degrees above, from the front left, a moderate telephoto lens with no wide-angle distortion), the same soft diffused studio light from one large softbox at the upper left, and the same soft natural contact shadow falling short towards the lower right beneath each object. Real materials rendered with true physical detail: thick uncoated cotton paper with a visible fine fibre and slightly soft edges, matte bead-blasted aluminium, matte soft-touch lacquer, smooth heavy coloured board. Restrained palette only: deep ink-blue #17284A (a clear dark blue navy, not purple, not black), clean cool paper white, pale blue-grey #D6E0F0, satin silver, and fountain-pen blue #2546A6 used only for the few ink marks. Top row, left: an opened envelope of heavy deep ink-blue paper lying almost flat with its flap open, and a folded sheet of white cotton letter paper half pulled out of it; the letter is blank. Top row, middle: a single sheet of thick white cotton paper lying flat at a slight angle, with a closed matte ink-blue fountain pen with a satin silver clip lying diagonally across its lower left corner; on the paper only a few very faint pale blue-grey bars where the lines of a form would be, and near the bottom right one short smooth fountain-pen-blue ink swoosh like a signature, but not letters. Top row, right: a slim matte silver aluminium laptop, open, in three-quarter view; its screen glows softly with an abstract video-call layout: a pale blue-grey background, one large rounded rectangle tile in a soft blue gradient and a short row of three small round buttons below it; no person, no face, no text on the screen. Bottom row, left: a closed document folder of smooth deep ink-blue board lying flat, with three or four white paper sheets sticking out a little at its top edge, and one pale blue-grey elastic band around it. Bottom row, middle: a small standing easel desk calendar with a white wire binding along the top; its top page is white paper with a clean grid of empty squares drawn in faint pale blue-grey lines, and one single square near the lower right is filled solid ink-blue; absolutely no numbers, no month name, no letters. Bottom row, right: a small white paper slip lying flat with a round ink-blue rubber-stamp impression on it, showing only a bold check mark inside a clean double ring (no words in the stamp), and right beside it a compact matte ink-blue desk stamp standing upright. Strictly no text, no letters, no numbers, no digits, no readable writing, no logos or brand marks, no people, no faces, no hands. No glossy plastic, no cartoon proportions, no toy-like look, no clay render, no isometric icon style, no outlines, no neon, no glow, no sparkles, no bright saturated colours, no colours other than the listed palette.
